senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; prob. fr. כרר with נ inserted, v. כִּרְכֵּר, cmp. חִינְגָּא)lute, cithern.
units: Arakh. 13ᵇ כ׳ של מקדש וכ׳ the kinnor of the Temple was seven-stringed.
<cite ref="Berakhot 3b:29">Ber. 3ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. I, 2ᵈ <he>כ׳ היה תלוי וכ׳</he> David had a lute suspended &c.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 101a:2">Snh. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>עשאוני בניך ככ׳ וכ׳</he> thy children made me (the Law) like an instrument upon which the scorners play; a. fr.—Pl. <he>כִּנּוֹרוֹת</he>, <he>כִּנּוֹרִים</he>, <cite ref="K00030"><he>כִּי׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shevuot 15b:8">Shebu. 15ᵇ</cite>. Kinnim III, 6 <he>בני מעיו לכ׳</he> its small bowels are used for strings for the cithern; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 47a:2">Ab. Zar. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>מהו לכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>לפארות</he>).
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 26:1">Pesik. R. s. 26</cite>; a. e.
